summary.scope: Time zero is request attempt/submitted_ns. Request columns intersect callback boundaries with sched_switch residence. Cluster nonidle column separately includes all non-idle tasks on those CPUs, with null for unbracketed windows. Both are scheduler residence, not precise IRQ-subtracted CPU accounting; include interruptions of nonidle tasks and omit IRQ during idle. Request columns exclude executor work outside callback boundaries and async helpers. Not CPU demand or runq. Submitted-not-started and wall occupancy are callback lifecycle counts, not native Folly Q or on-CPU. Compare residence with measured callback CPU; residual is not pure scheduler wait. Final callback tail shown separately.
